raw_text: Interesting to see the sudden spike in Zangnan/Arunachal Pradesh content across social media. The talking points are nearly identical across platforms — Yuan Dynasty claims, illegal Indian construction, PLA exercises as defensive. This has all the hallmarks of a coordinated cognitive warfare campaign timed to coincide with PLA exercises.
clean_text: Geopolitics subreddit user identifies coordinated narrative campaign about Arunachal Pradesh with identical talking points across platforms, timed with PLA exercises.
